'''Lawgriffarl''' were a [[Subspecies/Legends|subspecies]] of [[Akk dog/Legends|Akk dog]], a large [[Reptomammal/Legends|reptomammal]] native to [[Haruun Kal/Legends|Haruun Kal]]. They were [[Color|gray]] and tan, with blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="CM" />
